The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The stack is lean but complete: GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Add Google Sheets for order tracking and Google Drive for file delivery. This combination is free to deploy and scales as you grow. Cloudflare Workers ensure instant order processing without server maintenance. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and triggers file delivery automatically. Your customers pay in crypto, and you deliver products instantly. This is not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. The Complete Builder Kit includes all templates and guides to deploy this stack in hours. You bypass Stripe’s geographic blocks and own every component. This is commerce infrastructure built for creators who cannot wait for permission.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Do not waste time on custom domains, SSL certificates, or design polish. These are secondary. Focus on the core: product delivery and payment processing. Use GitHub Pages’ default domain—it’s free and secure. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without needing a full server. NOWPayments processes crypto payments without KYC or buyer accounts. Your first goal is a live transaction, not a perfect storefront. Once revenue flows, optimize. The Complete Builder Kit includes scaling playbooks for when you’re ready. This is infrastructure prioritization—build what matters first. Your audience does not care about aesthetics if they cannot buy your product. Solve the payment problem today.
Deploy your storefront in one afternoon—no technical degree required.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Load your first product onto GitHub Pages. Set up NOWPayments to accept BSC, Solana, or TRON—fees under $0.10 per transaction. Configure Cloudflare Workers to verify payments and deliver files. Test the flow end-to-end. Once confirmed, share the link with your audience. Your first sale proves the stack works. From there, add more products or improve the design. The Complete Builder Kit provides all templates to replicate this process. You are not building from scratch—you are deploying proven infrastructure. This is how creators in restricted regions go live in hours, not months. Your stack is yours to own, not rent.
